narratives.Overview: Panopticon is an AI agent orchestration framework — a multi-target Bun/TypeScript monorepo for orchestrating specialist agents (work, review, test, merge) across local and remote workspaces. This deft-augmented fork (eltmon/panopticon-deft) experiments with the deft framework on the Panopticon codebase without polluting the official eltmon/panopticon-cli repo.
narratives.TechStack: Multi-target monorepo: CLI (root @panctl/cli) + Desktop App (apps/desktop, Electron) + Web App (src/dashboard server + frontend). Primary language: TypeScript (some JavaScript may be present in build/config scripts). Runtime: Bun. Framework: Effect-TS (4.0.0-beta). Persistence: SQLite via @effect/sql-sqlite-bun. Build orchestration: Bun workspaces + tsdown.
narratives.Quality: Run task deft:check before every commit. Achieve >= 85% coverage overall + per-module. Store secrets in secrets/ dir. Caveat (#1027): Electron entry points in apps/desktop cannot be exercised headlessly — keep them thin (wiring only) and push testable logic into separate modules; configure the coverage tool's omit list to exclude the display-bound entry point so the 85% gate measures logic-bearing modules only. The CLI core and dashboard server test headlessly without issue.
narratives.Branching: Branch-based workflow (default). Direct commits to the default branch are blocked by the deft branch-protection policy.
